name: Blue Sky
effect: During your Knowledge Phase, gain the Power shown for this rotation.

name: Owl
effect: While in play, your Creatures have +1 Wisdom.

name: Chiropter
effect: Whenever Chiropter deals damage, gain that much Power.

name: Migration
effect: During your Knowledge Phase, rotate each opposing Creature back one step if possible.

name: Tsunami
effect: During your Knowledge Phase, rotate one of your other Knowledge cards one step.

name: Asteroid
effect: While in play, gain 1 Defense if the Creature facing Asteroid has no Knowledge card.

name: Hurricane
effect: While in play, your opponent cannot play Knowledge cards on the Creature facing Hurricane.

name: Delphinidae
effect: On play, draw one card from the Market without spending an action.

name: Galapago
effect: On final rotation, gain one extra action on your next turn.

name: Ursus
effect: When Ursus deals damage, deal 1 additional damage if the Creature facing Ursus has no Knowledge card.

name: Serpent
effect: On play, look at your opponent’s hand and choose one card for them to discard.

name: Earthquake
effect: During your Knowledge Phase, deal damage equal to the Wisdom of the Creature holding Earthquake.

name: Fire
effect: During your Knowledge Phase, discard every opposing Knowledge card in play that requires 2 Wisdom or less.

name: Lupus
effect: On final rotation, discard one opposing Knowledge card in play and gain one extra action on your next turn.
